title: The Ledger of Quiet Rooms
text:
# Abschnitt 6: The Third Column

**Note from Maren Voss to Ilya Brandt, slipped back through the laundry grate, 16 October, 06:03**

Ilya —

The spoon fits the vent screw in Room 3. Three turns and the grille comes free. I counted the strobe cycles against my wristwatch — forty-seven flickers per second, precise as the chapel clock's second hand. The fluorescent tubes in Corridor C have been doing this since Tuesday. You knew. You counted too.

The page you gave me: Column One is dates. Column Two is rooms. Column Three — I held it to the light behind the washbasin. Column Three is weights. Grams. Not rations. Something measured and removed.

The hatch weld is holding. I felt the vibration through the pipe chase at 05:52. They are not leaving.

**Memo from Sister Odile to Tobias Renn, tucked into the breviary, 16 October, 06:11**

Tobias —

The ninth column exists. I unpicked the hem of my cassock at 05:55. The second ledger lists: Room, Date, Weight, Duration, Witness, Seal, Transfer, Disposition, and — Parameter 12. A checkbox. Unchecked in every row but one. Room 4. 14 October. The forty-eight-hour gap.

The pneumatic tube to the archive is jammed. I tried to send the verification request at 06:07. Fine paper dust on the relay contacts, the gauge reads. The canister sits in the throat of the line, neither rising nor falling. The Warden's calibration data. Heavy for a single sheet.

Parameter 12 requires dual-signature verification before any interference with correspondence. The Warden's office has not signed. Neither have I.

**File entry, Warden's office, 16 October, 06:24**

Plenum breach imminent. Angle grinder operational at 06:18. Audio trunk JB-7: carrier tone stable at 47 Hz, all intercom channels compromised. Manual observation posts: Guest Voss removed vent grille in Room 3 at 06:01. Guest Brandt accessed pipe chase at 06:04. Sister Odile breached cassock hem at 05:55 — second ledger recovered, Parameter 12 column confirmed.

Pneumatic tube archive line: mechanical blockage at relay junction J-4. Paper particulate contamination on contacts. Calibration canister unrecoverable without line clearance. Parameter 9.3 verification incomplete — dual-signature block remains unsigned for Room 4 discrepancy.

Protection of life and physical integrity requires the trunk line be cut before the condensate reaches the junction. The strobe is the trigger. Forty-seven cycles per second. When the count reaches —

**[DOSSIER: RECEIVED | REF: B-12-06]**
